The '''Flandor system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the artwork known as the [[Flandorian flower floats]].<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Flandorian flower floats]]|system=Flandor [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Flandor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
